verdict.rationale: No evidence describes workflow-version pinning for in-flight runs, deterministic replay guarantees, or any mechanism to keep already-started runs on the code version they began with while new versions roll out — the docs cover retries, concurrency, cron, self-hosting, and CLI tooling but never versioning/determinism semantics. This is a reasonable axis for a durable workflow engine, so absence of evidence means 'none' rather than 'na'.
